sector.assessable_disclosure: Notice should disclose biometric collection, specific purpose and retention period, obtain written release, and publish a retention/destruction schedule.

sector.law_name: Capture or Use of Biometric Identifier Act (CUBI)
sector.assessable_disclosure: Notice should disclose biometric capture, obtain consent, and describe retention/destruction (generally within one year of purpose expiry).
Notice should disclose biometric enrollment for commercial purposes, provide notice/consent or an opt-out mechanism.

Maintain a Consumer Health Data Privacy Policy listing categories collected, sources, purposes, categories shared and specific affiliates/third parties, and how to exercise rights; separate consent to collect and to share.

sector.citation: Nev. Rev. Stat. ch. 603A (consumer health data provisions)
sector.assessable_disclosure: Publish a consumer health data privacy policy disclosing categories collected, sources, purposes, categories shared and third parties/affiliates, and rights; affirmative consent to collect and share.

sector.law_name: Connecticut Consumer Health Data Amendment (PA 23-56 / CTDPA)
sector.citation: Conn. Pub. Act No. 23-56 (amending Conn. Gen. Stat. §§ 42-515 to 42-525)
sector.assessable_disclosure: Disclose categories of consumer health data processed and purposes, categories shared and third parties, and rights; consent before collecting or sharing consumer health data.

sector.law_name: California Data Broker Registration Act, as amended by the Delete Act (SB 362)
sector.assessable_disclosure: Register annually with the CPPA and disclose categories of personal information collected (incl. sensitive/minors' data), collection/selling practices, and opt-out/deletion links.

sector.law_name: Vermont Data Brokers and Consumer Protection (Act 171)
sector.assessable_disclosure: Register annually and disclose whether/how consumers may opt out of collection/databases/sales, prior-year breaches, and minors'-data practices.

sector.citation: Tex. Bus. & Com. Code ch. 509 (registration at § 509.005)
sector.assessable_disclosure: Register annually with the Texas Secretary of State and post required disclosures about data-broker practices and security program.
Register annually with the Oregon DFR and declare whether/how Oregon residents may opt out of collection, sale, or licensing of brokered personal data.
